name: Release Gate Assessment (Work Order v7)
summary: NO-CAP (SIH26188 Vibe-Check-point) successfully completed all verification phases (Phase 0 through Phase R). All core invariants hold without degradation.

invariant_fs.detail: Under no condition or failure mode does screening autonomously issue a CLEAR verdict. Degraded, fallback, or unverified inputs route strictly to REVIEW or REJECT_LIKELY.

invariant_auth.detail: All protected routes enforce role-based access control and fail closed (HTTP 401/403) with zero operational telemetry or credential leakage.

biometric_zero_storage.detail: Zero raw facial crops, webcam frames, or unmasked biometric files are written to disk or database. Ephemeral buffers are unlinked and scrubbed.

pics_privacy.detail: Zero private filenames, personal descriptors, or raw images from pics/ are committed to git or leaked into reports.

capabilities: Layout-mode PDF stream extraction preserving columnar geometries
Form-7 Rule 16(2) multi-column driving licence parser
MRZ adaptive CLAHE and check-digit recovery
Aadhaar Verhoeff dihedral group D5 checksum
Income Tax PAN alphanumeric syntax validation
Cross-field temporal sequence checks (issue < expiry, plausible DOB, holder name vs MRZ)
64-bit dHash perceptual hashing fallback under Invariant FS contract (Tier 2)
Multi-frame EAR eye-blink and head-movement anti-spoofing
